composition.serve_who: This is a BUILDING/STRUCTURAL GA — "Steering System GA" (108-01-150-001) — showing the physical arrangement, positions, and specs of the twin-wheel + autopilot steering system: rudder stocks, bearing structures, tiller arms, sheave/track/car mechanical linkage, rod links, and the autopilot ram, all mounted port/stbd mirrored about CL between BHD L and the tri-beams. Callouts and BOM balloons all name components of this one steering assembly, so the whole sheet serves node 150-steering-system, with the rudder blades themselves and the autopilot ram sub-parts attaching to their own established/registered nodes (150-rudder-blades, 150-autopilot-system) per the register.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Steering System (wheel-driven mechanical linkage: sheaves, track, car, tiller arms, rod links)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The plan view, Detail A, Port Lower Sheave Box Detail, Sections B-B, D and E, and the BOM (items 1, 6-17) all describe the wheel-to-rudder mechanical steering train (upper/lower sheave boxes, track, car, Vectran line, rod links, tiller arms). This is the core mechanical steering linkage distinct from the rudder blades and autopilot ram, so it is composed under the main Steering System node.

functions.label: Wheel steering transmission (sheave/track/car/Vectran line linkage)
functions.what_it_does: Transmits helm input from each of the two steering wheels via a Vectran line running over aluminium sheaves (upper sheave box at BHD L, lower sheave box near hull shell) through a track-mounted car, converting wheel rotation into linear car travel that pulls the rod links to the tiller arms, turning both rudders in coordination.
key_components: Rod link carbon tube + BHD fittings + M16 ball joints — item 15
functions.sheet_region: Detail A (top center-left, scale 1:10); Port Lower Sheave Box Detail (top center-right, NTS); Plan View (scale 1:20, mid-right); Section B-B (scale 1:20, center)

flow_scenarios.path: Wheel input (off-sheet) -> Vectran line -> upper sheave box (fixed to BHD L) -> track/car assembly -> lower sheave box -> rod links (2044mm at neutral, giving 1.8° toe-in) -> port and stbd tiller arms -> rudder stocks centered

Wheel rotation -> Vectran line pulls car along 1100mm track -> car travel limited by E-glass wedge stops at track ends -> rod links transmit push/pull to both tiller arms simultaneously -> both rudders turn together (Ackermann effect: inside/outside rudder angles differ per table, e.g. at car position 212mm from CL, inside rudder 20°, outside rudder 16.0°)
One rod link fails -> corresponding tiller arm loses direct linkage -> other rudder remains actively controlled via its own intact rod link -> one rudder still active per system safety notes

functions.label: Tiller arm assemblies (port/stbd)
functions.what_it_does: Converts linear rod-link motion into rotary torque applied directly to each rudder stock, port and stbd mirrored.
key_components: Port assembled racing tiller arm 1400mm arm 600/240 — item 16
Stbd assembled racing tiller arm 1400mm arm 600/240 — item 17
functions.sheet_region: Plan view (mid-right); Detail E (scale 1:5, lower area); Section C-C (bottom-left)

flow_scenarios.path: Rod link -> tiller arm ball-joint connection -> rudder stock -> rudder blade rotates; STBD mirrors PORT arrangement

functions.label: Track support structural mounting
functions.what_it_does: Provides the structural mounting base for the sheave/car track, tapping-plate reinforced.

equipment_groups.dry_data: Rod link length 2044mm nominal at neutral (adjustable 2025-2056mm range for 0-3° toe-in fine tuning); car race ±365mm from CL; track length 1100mm

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Bearing structures, rudder stock, rudder retainer, water-tight tube and rudder blade section views all describe the rudder assembly itself, which already has an established node with prior structural facts from this same GA — this sheet adds bearing/structural specifics.

functions.label: Rudder stock bearing support (upper + lower)
functions.what_it_does: Supports and locates the rudder stock at two points (upper bearing near deck/BHD L, lower bearing near hull shell bottom), allowing rotation while sealing against water ingress.
key_components: Water tight system neoprene tube D.305mm — item 6
functions.sheet_region: Detail D (scale 1:5, lower-left, upper bearing area); Section B-B (center); Section C-C through rudder blade (bottom-left, view rotated 26°); Upper/Lower bearing structure callouts on perspective view (see DWG 108-05-151-001 / -002)

equipment_groups.dry_data: Rudder stock diameters: 220mm at bottom bearing, 180mm at top bearing; G10 spacers 30mm at top bearing (per Section B-B); datum 0 established at Section C-C for blade depth 1493mm and stock offset 1685mm

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The autopilot ram (item 19) and its dedicated 'AUTOPILOT RAM SUPPORT' callout, bolted through BHD L with bonded tapping plates, form the third independent steering path (pilot) noted in the system safety notes — distinct from the wheel-driven linkage, warranting attachment to the dedicated autopilot node.

functions.label: Autopilot ram drive
functions.what_it_does: Provides the third, independent steering path directly actuating the rudder linkage without operator wheel input, per system safety note ('3 independent systems: 2 wheels + pilot').
key_components: Autopilot ram support bracket, bolted through BHD L with bonded tapping plates on fwd face
functions.sheet_region: Plan view, center (item 19 balloon); callout 'AUTOPILOT RAM SUPPORT IS BOLTED THROUGH BHD L / BOND TAPPING PLATES ON FWD FACE' near plan view center-left

flow_scenarios.path: Autopilot control signal (off-sheet) -> ram extends/retracts (300mm stroke) -> acts on steering linkage independent of wheel Vectran line -> both rudders move together
Both wheel steering paths fail -> pilot ram remains functional -> pilot still in control of rudders per safety notes

equipment_groups.dry_data: 300mm stroke ram, model CLO-75N per BOM item 19; ram support bolted through BHD L, tapping plates bonded on fwd face

infrastructure.system_name: Structural mounting (tri-beams, partitions, bulkhead BHD L, hull shell)
facts: Tri-beam 11 and tri-beams 6+7 are the structural beams the steering linkage penetrates/is supported from; a penetration must be made in the tri-beam to suit pilot rod movement (callout, plan view center)
Partition LM1 (port) and LM2 (stbd) are bulkhead partitions adjacent to each rudder stock, providing local structural support for sheave boxes
BHD L is the bulkhead through which the autopilot ram support is bolted and where the upper sheave box is mounted
Sheave boxes are to be bonded horizontally (callout, plan view right side) — an assembly instruction, not a flow scenario
Station reference STN 10 marks a hull structural station at 651mm on deck inner skin (dimension chain, plan view)
DWL (design waterline) and DATUM 0 are structural/geometric references used across plan/section views for dimensioning bearing and rudder blade positions

discarded_as_clutter: Perspective View / Section labels (Detail A, Section B-B, C-C, D, E) — view/scale metadata only, not equipment facts
Standard notes box (do not scale, projection angle, dimension tolerances, break sharp edges) — drawing meta
Approved/Reviewed/title block signatures and dates — administrative meta
Revision block (First issue, Dims added, Modification) — administrative meta

uncertainties: Part numbers for bearing/housing items (e.g. 8032-220, 8038P-180) are legible in BOM but treated as function-identifying only; exact tolerance/material grade beyond GRP/ALU not further specified on this sheet.

Exact routing of Vectran line between upper and lower sheave boxes inside the hull (concealed by hull shell in perspective view) is not fully traceable — general path only, per drawn sheave/track arrangement.
